purpose: define, BEFORE any benefit predictor exists, exactly how a benefit label would have to be constructed, so a future phase cannot define it post hoc to fit its own results

label_definition.geometry_source_required_for_a_DEPLOYABL: PREDICTED (the model's own prediction), never the ground truth
label_definition.why_the_distinction_is_mandatory: an oracle-geometry label would teach a predictor to reproduce ground-truth localisation, which is not available at deployment. Phase 22's oracle numbers exist to bound the problem, not to train on.

empty_roi_handling.rationale: no regional pass is executed, so the fused map equals the global map and the gain is exactly zero

weak_label_option.warning: epsilon must be declared before training and must not be tuned on the evaluation population

required_before_any_training: the label geometry source is fixed to PREDICTED
the dead-band epsilon (if used) is declared in advance
the TRAIN/VAL split for label construction is fixed
no TEST data participates in label construction
the label is computed with the frozen Phase-22 decision rule
known_limitations_of_the_label: it inherits every error of the global model that defines the ROI
it is not identifiable where the global prediction is empty
it is defined only for the ROI rule frozen in the Phase-22 protocol
a change to the ROI rule changes the label, so the rule must be frozen alongside the predictor
